about.title: About
content: I build production-grade web platforms where design, API contracts, AI automation, and product thinking work together.
My work spans React/Next.js applications, Node.js backends, database design, and AI-assisted workflows for teams shipping faster without compromising quality.
I’m especially interested in AI-native product experiences, scalable APIs, and audio intelligence systems.
highlights: Full-stack ownership from API design to deployment
AI product workflows with Claude and Gemini
Frontend systems with reusable component architecture

bullets: Own full-stack development for internal AI products across TypeScript/React and Node.js/MySQL.
Design and optimize MySQL schemas for high-volume audio analysis.
Build the APIs behind transcription, diarization, and Gemini-based scoring used in production by clients.
Core contributor to Audiofy, from initial architecture to release.
Owned front-end features for UK-based clients, translating stakeholder requirements into production UI.
Built a reusable React component library that reduced duplicate code and sped up new screens.
Delivered full-stack features from API design to UI with consistent API contracts.
Shipped accessible, responsive client-facing products and passed 160+ GitHub contributions within months.
Learned and shipped Next.js on live client projects.
